I don't know OrderLoop's refund window. It isn't something I can recall, and you asked me not to open any files, so I haven't checked the code or docs.

Return windows are usually "within 30 days", which includes day 30. If OrderLoop uses a 30-day window, a request made exactly 30 days after delivery would not be late. If the window is shorter, such as 14 or 7 days, it would be late. This answer assumes the common 30-day, inclusive rule. If you want it confirmed, I can search the repo for the refund-window logic.
